test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

EXCITED
solution: The correct answer is '**Bored**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Excited**' is '**Bored**'. • **Excited**: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm; not calm. (उत्तेजित, व्‍यग्र; अधीर) • *Example: Are you getting **excited** about your holiday?* • **Bored**: feeling tired and perhaps slightly annoyed because something is not interesting or because you do not have anything to do. (कुछ काम न होने अथवा अरुचिकर होने के कारण थकान एवं चिड़चिड़ापन, ऊबा हुआ) • *Example: The children get **bored** on long journeys.* **Correct Answer:__** *Bored.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Active**: involved in the activity; lively. (सक्रिय, क्रियाशील; चुस्‍त, फुरतीला, जीवंत) • **Busy**: having a lot of work or tasks to do; not free; working on something. (ख़ाली नहीं; काम में लगा हुआ; कार्यरत, व्‍यस्‍त) • **Thrilled**: cause (someone) to have a sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure. (रोमांचित, पुलकित) 40:T515, The correct answer is **'Produce positive results'.**
